title_zh: 修订健康宣传晚会海报并交专业人员复核

scenario.label_zh: 修订健康宣传活动海报
scenario.goal_zh: 核对活动海报的称谓、费用信息和尊重性措辞，并安排专业人员复核健康内容

context_zh: 社区活动组织者萨娜与迈尔斯审阅一张虚构的健康宣传晚会海报，重点是活动信息及尊重参与者的表达。
author: author-phase06-c

sentences.speaker: Sana
sentences.text: The heading says HIV and AIDS awareness evening. Is the rest of the poster ready?

sentences.speaker: Miles
sentences.text: Almost. Have we described the speakers appropriately? This draft calls Leila a doctor, but she is a nurse.

sentences.speaker: Sana
sentences.text: Good catch. Use the job title she supplied. And this photograph of a crying stranger is not appropriate; it makes assumptions about people's lives.

sentences.speaker: Miles
sentences.text: I will replace it with a photograph of the venue. Shall we mention the workshops under the main talk?

sentences.speaker: Sana
sentences.text: Yes. The main talk and the associated activities are all free. That needs to be clear.

sentences.speaker: Miles
sentences.text: I can make those changes now. Who checks the health information?

sentences.speaker: Sana
sentences.text: Leila has agreed to review it. Send the new draft to her and wait for her response before we print.

sentences.speaker: Miles
sentences.text: Understood. I will correct her title, change the photograph, and mark the whole file as a draft.
